name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0
description: NIST Cybersecurity Framework — voluntary guidance for organizations to manage and reduce cybersecurity risk. Updated to v2.0 in 2024 with a new Govern function.

controls.title: Govern — Organizational Context
controls.description: The circumstances, mission, stakeholder expectations, and legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements regarding cybersecurity risk management are understood.

controls.title: Govern — Risk Management Strategy
controls.description: The organization's priorities, constraints, risk tolerances and assumptions are established, communicated, and used to support operational risk decisions.

controls.title: Govern — Roles, Responsibilities, and Authorities
controls.description: Cybersecurity roles, responsibilities, and authorities to foster accountability, performance assessment, and continuous improvement are established and communicated.

controls.title: Govern — Policy
controls.description: Organizational cybersecurity policy is established, communicated, and enforced.

controls.title: Govern — Oversight
controls.description: Results of organization-wide cybersecurity risk management activities and performance are used to inform, improve, and adjust the risk management strategy.

controls.title: Identify — Asset Management
controls.description: Assets that enable the organization to achieve business purposes are identified and managed consistent with their relative importance to organizational objectives and the organization's risk strategy.

controls.title: Identify — Risk Assessment
controls.description: Cybersecurity risk to organizational operations and assets, individuals, other organizations, and the Nation are understood by the organization.

controls.title: Identify — Improvement
controls.description: Improvements to organizational cybersecurity risk management processes, procedures and activities are identified across all CSF Functions.

controls.title: Protect — Identity Management, Authentication and Access Control
controls.description: Access to physical and logical assets is limited to authorized users, services, and hardware and managed commensurate with the assessed risk of unauthorized access.

controls.title: Protect — Awareness and Training
controls.description: The organization's personnel are provided with cybersecurity awareness and training so that they can perform their cybersecurity-related tasks.

controls.title: Protect — Data Security
controls.description: Data are managed consistent with the organization's risk strategy to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information.

controls.title: Protect — Platform Security
controls.description: The hardware, software (including firmware and code), and services of physical and virtual platforms are managed consistent with the organization's risk strategy.

controls.title: Protect — Technology Infrastructure Resilience
controls.description: Security architectures are managed with the organization's risk strategy to protect asset confidentiality, integrity, and availability, and organizational resilience.

controls.title: Detect — Continuous Monitoring
controls.description: Assets are monitored to find anomalies, indicators of compromise, and other potentially adverse events.

controls.title: Detect — Adverse Event Analysis
controls.description: Anomalies, indicators of compromise, and other potentially adverse events are analyzed to characterize the events and detect cybersecurity incidents.

controls.title: Respond — Incident Management
controls.description: Responses to detected cybersecurity incidents are managed.

controls.title: Respond — Incident Analysis
controls.description: Investigations are conducted to ensure effective response and support forensics and recovery activities.

controls.title: Respond — Incident Response Reporting and Communication
controls.description: Response activities are coordinated with internal and external stakeholders as required by laws, regulations, or policies.

controls.title: Respond — Incident Mitigation
controls.description: Activities are performed to prevent expansion of an event, mitigate its effects, and resolve the incident.

controls.title: Recover — Incident Recovery Plan Execution
controls.description: Restoration activities are performed to ensure operational availability of systems and services affected by cybersecurity incidents.

controls.title: Recover — Incident Recovery Communication
controls.description: Restoration activities are coordinated with internal and external parties.
